column18: Mappable: No. Mediation Inconsistency: DOLCE's amount-of-matter is a subclass of DOLCE's physical-endurant. DOLCE's physical-endurant is equivalent to GFO'sDiscrete_presential. GFO's Discrete_presential is disjoint with GFO's Mass_Entity. GFO's Mass_entity is equivalent to GFO's Amount_of_substrate. This inconsistency is a result of the OWL DisjointClasses class axiom. In this equivalence relation; both DOLCE's amount-of-matter and GFO's Amount_of_substrate are disjoint; hence the two classes cannot be equivalent. Mediation Method: Manual

Mappable: No. Mediation Inconsistency: DOLCE's set is a subclass of DOLCE's abstract. DOLCE's abstract is equivalent to GFO's Abstract. GFO's Abstract is a subclass of GFO's Item. GFO's Set is disjoint to GFO's Item. This inconsistency is a result of the OWL DisjointClasses class axiom. In this equivalence relation. GFO's Set is disjoint to a superclass of DOLCE's set. hence the two classes cannot be equivalent. Mediation Method: Manual

Mappable: No. Mediation Inconsistency: The range for DOLCE's has-quale is quale. The range for GFO's has_value is property_value. DOLCE's quale is a subclass of DOLCE's abstract. DOLCE's abstract is equivalent to GFO's Abstract. GFO's Property_value is a subclass of GFO's Concrete. GFO's Concrete is disjoint to GFO's Abstract.
